tools.name: get_services
tools.description: What Bay Area Mobile Dog Wash offers: full-service mobile dog washing at the customer's home (San Jose + nearby South Bay), prices by dog size, add-ons, and the first-wash discount. Call this first to answer questions about the service.

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: List open appointment times for a mobile dog wash. Returns a map of date (YYYY-MM-DD) to UTC ISO start times. Present times to the user in Pacific Time (America/Los_Angeles). Defaults to the next 14 days.

tools.name: book_wash
tools.description: Request a mobile dog wash at one of the times from get_available_slots. IMPORTANT: this files a booking REQUEST — the owner confirms it shortly afterward and the customer then receives the confirmation email; tell the user that. tools.name: find_page
tools.description: Search every page on the Bay Area Mobile Dog Wash website by keyword and get back real URLs. Use this whenever the customer asks something get_services does not cover — a specific breed, a coat or skin problem (matting, shedding, fleas, skunk, itchy skin, anxious or senior dogs), a city, or a price

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_wash" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Request a mobile dog wash at one of the times from get_available_slots. IMPORTANT: this files a booking REQUEST — the owner confirms it shortly afterward and th…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_page · Private data: book_wash · Public sink: book_wash.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_page · Private data: book_wash · Public sink: book_wash

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
